body_long:
Margaux Séhébiade is one of the youngest five-star hotel directors in Europe. Since 14 May 2026 she has been Hotel Manager of the Hôtel Saint-Georges in Megève, a five-star Relais & Châteaux house and the first mountain address of Chapitre Six, the French collection founded by Nicolas Saltiel.

## Raised in the trade

Margaux Séhébiade is the daughter of a hotelier and grew up in the industry. Before managing anyone, she learned the operational trades one by one: guest relations at Sofitel, housekeeping, and food and beverage service at a Relais & Châteaux house.

She then worked the front desk within Hyatt, first in Dublin, then at the Hôtel du Palais in Biarritz, the palace of The Unbound Collection by Hyatt. She stayed with the group but left operations to join the sales team of the Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile, a 995-room hotel.

## Two reopenings with Bertrand Hospitality

In September 2023, while completing a master's degree in law, economics and management at the Sorbonne, she joined Bertrand Hospitality as Deputy Manager of the Château des Fleurs and the Hôtel Norman in Paris. Her brief was the reopening of both houses, historically four-star hotels repositioned as five-star.

After almost three years with the Bertrand group, she joined Chapitre Six in May 2026 to run the Saint-Georges.

In a message shared when she took the role, she thanked Nicolas Saltiel and Nadège Ryan for their trust, and Franck Farneti and Anthony Torkington for their advice and support.

## A chalet reborn

The Saint-Georges is a historic chalet in the heart of the village. Chapitre Six reopened it on 19 December 2025, after a complete redesign by the British designer Luke Edward Hall, who built the interiors around the legend of Saint George. The original wood panelling was kept and lightened; the piano bar plays with the dragon, and Le Trappeur, the bistro led by chef Jérôme Blanchetière, takes the wild boar as its emblem.

The house has 29 keys, a piano bar that stays lively late into the night, and a wellness area built around contrast therapy, with a Japanese sauna, hot and cold baths and treatments by myBlend by Clarins. In March 2026 it joined Relais & Châteaux.

Chapitre Six now runs nine hotels in France, from Paris and Barbizon to Saint-Tropez, Cap d'Antibes and Courchevel, with a new address in Cannes due in 2027.

## The signal

Her path is a reminder of how five-star directors are made. Front desk, housekeeping, service, sales, then two repositionings from four to five stars: by the time she took the keys of the Saint-Georges, she had seen the hotel from every side.

For hoteliers, the lesson is about breadth. Groups such as Chapitre Six are entrusting flagships to young managers, but to young managers who have already worked every department.

Congratulations to Margaux Séhébiade and the Saint-Georges team on her first season at the helm.
